item.title: Keycloak Token Exchange
item.description: At Bar-Code Developer Barcamp last week someone mentioned a feature named On behalf of in Microsoft Entra (in the context of a user requesting an Agent/LLM to query the database on her behalf). That lead me to the question: does keycloak support this as well? And indeed it does.
